episodes.partTitleEn: PART 1 — Arrival in Kanazawa & Bus Ride
episodes.descriptionJp: 花咲く高校生活を夢見る花帆。入学した蓮ノ空女学院は思い描いていた環境とはほど遠かったが、スクールアイドルクラブの梢と出会い……。
episodes.descriptionEn: Dreaming of a blooming high school life, Kaho boards the bus from Kanazawa Station alongside fellow first-year Sayaka Murano—only to discover Hasunosora is deep in the mountains.

episodes.descriptionEn: Despairing over the strict dorm rules, Kaho attempts a 'jailbreak' and encounters Kozue Otomune practicing as a school idol.
